deficits.evidence: No footway on the right side of the road, pedestrians must walk in the carriageway
deficits.suggestion: Construct a continuous, usable sidewalk on the right side of the road to provide a safe walking space for pedestrians.

deficits.evidence: Obstructions on the narrow left footway, reducing its usability
deficits.suggestion: Remove obstructions and widen the left footway to ensure it is fully accessible and usable for pedestrians.

deficits.evidence: Uneven sections on the left footway that pose trip hazards
deficits.suggestion: Repair and level the uneven sections of the left footway to eliminate trip hazards for pedestrians.

deficits.evidence: No crossing facility despite pedestrian demand
deficits.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing with refuge islands to facilitate safe crossing for pedestrians.

ratings.reason: The right side consists of a concrete barrier and grass with no pedestrian path.
The left footway is mostly obscured by the shelter structure, making obstructions hard to verify.
The resolution and angle do not allow for the detection of small uneven sections or trip hazards.
No marked pedestrian crossings are visible along the stretch of road shown.
